prompt: Pixel art animation sprite sheet for a retro 2D action RPG, the exact same character as in the reference image (Sylva, the forest huntress: leaf-green hood with a golden leaf ornament, long brown hair, olive leaf cloak, quiver of white-fletched arrows on her back, brown leather armor and boots, a wooden recurve bow). Four frames in one row, equal cells on a flat chroma green #00FF00 background, same size and same baseline, front view facing the camera, crisp pixel art with 1px dark outline like the reference. Every frame must keep the whole character no taller than the standing pose plus a small margin: the bow must never be held vertically above the head, it is held horizontally or diagonally close to the head. Frames left to right: 1) crouching low in a coiled stance, gathering wild primal energy, bow held close, cloak and hair already stirring; 2) rising up with her head thrown back in a battle cry, holding the bow horizontally in front of her chest with both hands, elbows wide; 3) the peak: standing wide, legs apart, chest out, bow held horizontally overhead at head height with both arms spread wide, a wild heroic roar, cloak flaring; 4) dropping into a fierce firm shooting stance with the bow drawn and an arrow aimed forward, cloak billowing. Big dramatic readable poses, no text, no letters, no effects outside the character.
